ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your stainless steel surfaces are not looking their best. We understand your frustration and we want to help!

If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area or if chlorine is present in your environment additional maintenance will be needed to prevent rust and keep up the appearance of the exterior stainless steel parts. Below are a couple of helpful tips:

1.  At the first sign of staining, discoloration, or surface rust we recommend cleaning with a stainless steel cleaner, such as Noxon 7 to remove the rust, followed by the Weber Stainless Steel Polish to preserve the shine. Continue to use the stainless steel polish periodically to keep your grill looking its best.

2.  Once a week we recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.  This will remove any harmful salt or chemicals from the grill’s exterior.

3.  We suggest only covering your grill in the event of inclement weather. 

We are sending you a follow-up email to make sure that you have everything you need to keep your grill looking great for years to come! Thanks again for being a Weber fan!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to learn that your new grill was not working for you after you received it. All of our regulators are inspected for damage before our products are sent out, so it is very unusual to hear that your regulator wasn't working.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
